counts['month']=pd.to_datetime(counts['month'])
from scipy import sparse
def poisson_twfe_quick(radius, outcome_col, window_months=None):
    import time
    t0=time.time()
    all_months=pd.date_range('2012-07-01','2026-10-01',freq='MS')
    idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([sites.site_id.unique(), all_months], names=['site_id','month'])
    panel=pd.DataFrame(index=idx).reset_index()
    panel=panel.merge(sites[['site_id','install_month']], on='site_id', how='left')
    sub=counts[counts.radius_m==radius][['site_id','month',outcome_col]]
    panel=panel.merge(sub,on=['site_id','month'],how='left')
    panel[outcome_col]=panel[outcome_col].fillna(0).astype(int)
    panel['treated']=(panel['month']>=panel['install_month']).astype(int)
    panel['rel']=(panel['month'].dt.year-panel['install_month'].dt.year)*12+(panel['month'].dt.month-panel['install_month'].dt.month)
    if window_months is not None:
        panel=panel[(panel['rel']>=-window_months)&(panel['rel']<=window_months)]
    y=panel[outcome_col].values.astype(float)
    site_ids=panel['site_id'].values
    uniq_sites=np.unique(site_ids)
    site_map={s:i for i,s in enumerate(uniq_sites)}
    site_idx=np.array([site_map[s] for s in site_ids])
    months=panel['month'].values
    uniq_months=np.unique(months)
    month_map={m:i for i,m in enumerate(uniq_months)}
    month_idx=np.array([month_map[m] for m in months])
    treated=panel['treated'].values.astype(float)
    ns=len(uniq_sites); nm=len(uniq_months)
    n=len(panel)
    rows=[]; cols=[]; data=[]
    for i in range(n):
        rows.append(i); cols.append(0); data.append(1.0)
    for i,tr in enumerate(treated):
        if tr!=0:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(1); data.append(tr)
    for i,si in enumerate(site_idx):
        if si<ns-1:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(2+si); data.append(1)
    for i,mi in enumerate(month_idx):
        if mi<nm-1:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(2+(ns-1)+mi); data.append(1)
    X2=sparse.csr_matrix((data,(rows,cols)),shape=(n,2+(ns-1)+(nm-1)))
    p2=X2.shape[1]
    beta=np.zeros(p2)
    for it in range(30):
        eta=X2.dot(beta)
        eta=np.clip(eta,-15,15)
        mu=np.exp(eta); mu=np.clip(mu,1e-8,1e6)
        z=eta+(y-mu)/mu
        w=mu
        sqrtW=np.sqrt(w)
        Xw=X2.multiply(sqrtW[:,None])
        zw=z*sqrtW
        res=sparse.linalg.lsqr(Xw,zw,atol=1e-6,btol=1e-6,iter_lim=2000)
        beta_new=res[0]
        if np.max(np.abs(beta_new-beta))<1e-4:
            beta=beta_new
            break
        beta=beta_new
    # compute clustered SE
    eta=X2.dot(beta); mu=np.exp(np.clip(eta,-15,15))
    resid=y-mu
    XtWX=(X2.T @ sparse.diags(mu) @ X2).toarray()
    try:
        bread=np.linalg.inv(XtWX)
    except:
        bread=np.linalg.pinv(XtWX)
    meat=np.zeros((p2,p2))
    for g in uniq_sites:
        mask=site_ids==g
        Xg=X2[mask].toarray()
        sg=Xg.T @ resid[mask]
        meat+=np.outer(sg,sg)
    V=bread@meat@bread
    se=np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    coef=beta[1]; se_t=se[1]
    print(f"done r={radius} w={window_months} time {time.time()-t0:.1f}s coef {coef:.3f} se {se_t:.3f}")
    return coef,se_t
